name: SAR9 SP Khaki
lead: The SAR9 SP stands out with its technical capabilities that meet all the superior features of the SAR9 series.
description: The SAR9 SP stands out with its technical capabilities that meet all the superior features of the SAR9 series.

Developed according to the needs of the Special Forces Command and the Turkish Armed Forces to respond to different and specialized needs. Similar to other SAR9’s, the pistol that enables safe and practical use with polymer frame and alloy forged steel barrel comes with suppressor height sights with firing pin block and trigger safety. SAR9 SP also contains improvement options with silencer connection, magazine well and lanyard ring.
